content_of_post_to_answer: Is Tahajjud good for my really bad overthinking?
answer: Tahajjud can be deeply calming for overthinking, but perhaps not because it magically removes thoughts. Its value may come from changing your relationship with them. Late-night prayer creates a space where the mind stops fighting every worry and places those burdens somewhere beyond itself. Many people confuse peace with having no thoughts; sometimes peace is being able to hold those thoughts without being controlled by them. The quiet of Tahajjud can teach that distinction.
